name: Dementia Assistant
tagline: AR glasses that show the name and relationship of the person you are talking to, with live captions, for people with dementia.
problem: People with dementia struggle to recognise faces and follow conversations.
solution: A custom face-recognition model with an AR lens on smart glasses labels known people with their relationship, and live transcription supports short-term memory.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a family member and see their name and relationship.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Trained its own face model because the platform lacked one.

lessons: Wearables suit memory aids: the help appears where the person is looking.
